name: instagram
description: Instagram direct messages: read and send your Instagram account's chats here, never through the browser. A real user, not a bot: chats, messages, photos and videos, voice messages, reactions, edits, unsends, groups, pins, bans and blocks. The login is taken from the Instagram session in bia's Chrome. Received files are saved in /home/bia/files/inbox/instagram/; voice messages arrive transcribed as [speech <lang>]; shared posts and reels arrive as [shared] lines with their link; edits, unsends and reactions as [edited <id>], [deleted] and [reaction]. No calls. The login is restored by itself at boot.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|log into my instagram -> discover(path='mcp/instagram', enable=true); instagram_login()  (if Chrome is not signed in: chrome_start, sign in at https://www.instagram.com/accounts/login/, then instagram_login() again)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send hi to that instagram chat -> instagram_send(chat_id='17841400000000000', text='hi')
ann|instagram:17841400000000000|<issued>|<delivered>|[shared] Reel — https://www.instagram.com/reel/abc/ -> say(identity='ann', channel='instagram:17841400000000000', message='Love it!')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|pin my chat with Ann on instagram -> instagram_pin(chat_id='17841400000000000', on=true)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make @ann an admin of that instagram group -> instagram_set_admin(chat_id='340282366841710300949128', member='@ann')
